head: Opera Neon builds browser extensions from a chat, no coding needed
dek: Opera's AI browser Neon can now make a browser extension from a description you type in its chat. It shows a preview first, and you install the result with one click.
details: To change the extension later, you ask in the same chat and reinstall it. Extensions you want to share can be sent to Opera's add-ons store through its developer portal. Opera plans to bring the builder to its other desktop browsers later. Opera Neon is a paid browser.
where: Opera Neon, out now; Opera's other desktop browsers later
means: If you use Opera Neon, you can make small browser tools for your own needs without writing code.
todo: In Opera Neon, describe the extension you want in the chat, check the preview, then install it. Only install extensions you understand.
thumb_words: OPERA NEON: EXTENSIONS FROM A CHAT
